How to Run the Table

Read it once, out loud if you want to. After that it's muscle memory and the Holy Spirit.

  1. Pick your lane. Letters if you like to spell it out, Words if meaning is your ministry, Verses if you're ready to carry whole scripture in your chest. All three roads lead to the same Word.
  2. Set the table. Choose who's playing — just you, the Scribe (our AI), or Pass & Play with somebody you love. Pick your level, your rack size, your tile style, your Bible version — ten translations deep — and the prophet who'll ride with you.
  3. Build. Tap tiles from your rack to lay them on the board, then hit the gold button to play. Every play scores. Every Kingdom word scores extra — and preaches.
  4. Watch the sidebar. The moment you play a word that lives in scripture, its verse lands in the Scripture tab beside you. That's the whole point: you're not just winning a game, you're collecting the Word.
  5. Talk to your prophet. Open Prophet Chat anytime. Ask for a word for your rack, a blessing over the game, or a verse for right now. Tell them how you're actually feeling — they answer with scripture, not small talk.
  6. Press play. The bar at the bottom runs worship pads underneath the whole game, with links out to Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube when you want your own soundtrack. Study hits different with a soundtrack.
Mode One · Letters

Spell It & Sell It

  • Tap rack tiles to build on the Selah Strip; tap a placed tile to take it back.
  • DL / TL double or triple that letter. DW / TW multiply the whole word. The strip reshuffles every turn, so stay ready.
  • Use your whole rack (5+ tiles) for the +35 Selah Bonus.
  • Stuck? Swap tiles with the bag or Pass — but swapping costs you the turn.
Mode Two · Words

Say It Like Scripture

  • Tap word tiles to lay a phrase of 3 or more, then press Speak the Phrase.
  • Gold-ringed tiles are Kingdom words: +8 each. Two or more together: +15 Kingdom Phrase.
  • Rebuild an actual line of scripture — Light of the World, Be Still and Know, The Lord Is My Shepherd — for +25 and the full verse card.
Mode Three · Verses

Rebuild the Verse

  • A verse from your chosen translation arrives scrambled. Tap the tiles back into order, one word at a time.
  • Wrong taps cost you points. A Hint reveals the next word for −8. Choose wisely.
  • Level 1 keeps the study guide open. By Level 3 it's closed and decoy words sneak in. By the third rebuild, the verse isn't on the screen anymore — it's in you.

The good stuff: Kingdom words (GRACE, SHEPHERD, COVENANT, REDEEMED…) pay +15 in Letters mode and pull their scripture into the sidebar with a full celebration. Infinite Mode removes the finish line — no target, no rounds, just building until somebody says selah. First to 150 takes it in a standard Letters game; Words runs 5 rounds; Verses ends when every builder finishes their verses. Light or dark, the table stays set — flip it up top anytime. On a phone, your prophet and the scriptures live behind the menu button in the game bar. Now go build something eternal.

    How to Play

    Welcome to the table, family. Three modes, one Word, and a prophet in your corner. Here's how we run it.

    Mode 1 · Letters — Tile Builder

    Tap tiles from your rack to build a word on the Selah Strip. Squares marked DL / TL double or triple that letter; DW / TW multiply the whole word — and the strip reshuffles every turn, so stay ready. Standard tile points apply, and using your whole rack (5+ tiles) earns the +35 Selah Bonus. Stuck? Swap tiles with the bag or pass — but swapping costs your turn.

    Kingdom Words ✦ — The Good Stuff

    The game holds a biblical vocabulary — GRACE, SHEPHERD, COVENANT, REDEEMED, words with weight. Play one and you earn +15 bonus points, the confetti falls, the scripture behind the word lands in your sidebar, and your prophet weighs in. Any word that lives in scripture surfaces its verse. Around here, words preach.

    Mode 2 · Words — Phrase Builder

    • You’re dealt whole word tiles (10–27, your choice).
    • Arrange at least 3 into a phrase and press Speak the Phrase.
    • Every Kingdom word adds +8. Two or more together: +15 “Kingdom Phrase.”
    • Rebuild an actual scripture phrase — Light of the World, Be Still and Know, The Lord Is My Shepherd — for +25 and the full verse card.

    Mode 3 · Verses — Verse Builder

    A verse from your chosen translation — all ten are at the table, from KJV to The Message to The Passion — is scrambled into word tiles. Tap them back into order. Wrong taps cost points; hints cost 8. Level 1 keeps the study guide open; by Level 3 the guide closes and decoy words sneak in. This is the memory mode: by the third rebuild, the verse isn't on the screen anymore. It's in you.

    Ways to Play

    • Solo Study — you, the tiles, and the target score. Quiet, deep, yours.
    • Vs. AI — the Scribe answers every play and gets sharper as your level rises. Bring your best.
    • Pass & Play — two players, one device, hidden racks. Game night rules apply.
    • Infinite Mode — no target, no clock, no finish line. Just build until somebody says selah.

    The Extras

    Your prophet rides in the sidebar — ask them for a word, a blessing, or a verse for right now, or just tell them how you're feeling. The bottom bar runs worship pads under the whole game, with links out to Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube. Flip light/dark up top whenever the mood shifts. Now — let's build.
